I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I haven't run it against a database.

It does three things, in this order:
1. It sets `status = 'queued'` on existing rows where `status` is NULL. This has to come first, because `SET NOT NULL` fails if any NULLs are left.
2. It sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. It sets the column to `NOT NULL`.

I didn't edit `001_init.sql`. Migrations are append-only because they've already run in prod, so the schema change goes in a new file.

The backfill marks every existing NULL-status export as `queued`. If some of those jobs have already finished or failed, you may want a different value for them.
